messages:
priya: Observed the eval-runner deadlock on staging after shard reschedule. Happens consistently when a worker preempts.

sam: Repro steps?

priya: 1) start 8 workers with small mem (g4dn). 2) kick off eval harness with 64 shards. 3) after ~2m, one worker gets OOM and is restarted, then the harness stalls.

kai: Logs?

priya: ```
[2026-03-18T14:12:33Z] shard_tracker: rescheduling shard=42 -> lease_lost
[2026-03-18T14:12:33Z] queue: inflight=64 queued=0
[2026-03-18T14:12:33Z] worker_manager: no available workers, waiting
[2026-03-18T14:12:34Z] shard_tracker: attempt_reschedule shard=42 -> waiting_for_worker
[2026-03-18T14:12:34Z] worker_manager: worker_returned id=wk-7
[2026-03-18T14:12:34Z] worker_manager: handing_shard shard=42 -> wk-7
[2026-03-18T14:12:34Z] shard_tracker: shard=42 reacquired, but lease ordering mismatch -> deadlock
``` 

lee: Hmm lease ordering mismatch... we saw similar with the old rescheduler bug but that was because reschedule and worker-returned handled under different locks.

sam: Can you run with DEBUG_LOCKS=1 and post stack traces when it stalls?

priya: Pushed a reproducer to my fork + CI: auth/priya/eval-deadlock-ssh. CI job failing: test-eval-runner-scale #4567

eval-ci: test-eval-runner-scale failed on step 'integration-run' (exit code 1). Logs: /artifacts/4567/integration.log

kai: Quick read: looks like rescheduler holds shard_tracker mutex while waiting for worker from worker_manager which itself tries to acquire same shard lock to mark 'handing_shard'. Classic lock inversion.

lee: Proposed fix: reorder so shard_tracker enqueues to scheduling queue (non-blocking) then releases shard lock, let worker_manager pick up and mark lease. Also add lease_version check to avoid reassigning old leases.

sam: Sounds right. Small mitigation: set shard_reschedule_backoff to linear min 200ms to avoid immediate tight loop.

priya: I'll open PR with both changes + test that simulates worker OOM. Linking here when ready.

priya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness/pull/3192 (draft) - includes lock reorder + lease_version guard + config var

lee: Nice. Also add CI job that runs with low-memory workers to catch regressions.

ops-bot: @channel Heads-up: Staging runs will be noisy while PR is tested :warning:

sam: LGTM pending unit test for scheduling queue behavior. I'll review tomorrow.

priya: thx everyone. will update with test results and CI rerun.
